rules_text.raw: This spell also applies to telepathy, cutting off any mental communication within the area. At the time of casting, you can choose to be immune to your own mythic silence effect and can designate up to one creature per tier to also gain this immunity. Creatures immune to the mythic silence are subject to sonic effects as normal.
